headline: This change plans work outside its authorized edit roots.
reason: the task plan targets repository roots that no edit authority covers, so apply stays blocked until a human decides.
value: Granting scopes edit authority to this change alone: the grant is recorded in the change's ledger, auditable, and dies with archive.
evidence: /workspace/service-a is a Git repository root outside the authorized edit roots
/workspace/service-b is a Git repository root outside the authorized edit roots

choices.label: Grant this change edit authority over the named roots
choices.effect: This change's apply actor may edit the named repositories. The grant is per-change, audited (who, when, which roots), and dies with archive; nothing is granted to any other change.
choices.invocation: gentle-ai sdd-attempt grant --cwd "/workspace/planning" --change multi-repo-rollout --root "/workspace/service-a" --root "/workspace/service-b" --actor maintainer --reason edit-authority-consent-granted --request-id grant-ce874466367354a2 --change-instance sdd-b2f4c0a1d8e64953a7c15b9d3e0f2a68

choices.label: Keep the change blocked
choices.effect: The change stays blocked(edit_authority_missing) and nothing is persisted. Both exits stay open: edit the change's tasks.md so no work unit targets an unauthorized root, or grant authority with the named grant invocation.

off_path.note: To keep this change single-repository instead, edit its tasks.md so no work unit targets an unauthorized root, then re-enter through 'gentle-ai sdd-status multi-repo-rollout --cwd "/workspace/planning"'.
